description: Nominal presidio-hardened/energy-reading@1 Layer-0 reading (pat Energy Arc v0.24 'Sign the watt', L-EN-4) — RESERVED, not yet emitted by a shipped producer. A 5-minute serving-layer window measured by Kepler, key-lessly emitted by pat and signed into the frozen evidence-ref@1 envelope by the bridge sidecar (v0.17 pattern). Carries `layer` (a pat serving layer) and NOT `strategy` — exactly one of the two is always present. `parents` is absent — ADR-0002 P3 omits it when empty. The payload carries no type id of its own: the Layer-0 wrapper's `schema` is authoritative. `meter` names the measuring device and is deliberately distinct from the family `source` (= producer repo) at the wrapper/envelope levels. energy_wh and mean_power_w are shortest-round-trip decimal STRINGS, never floats (ADR-0001 D1): 12.5 Wh over 300 s == 150.0 W, and the conformance suites re-derive the mean power from the energy and the window. `energy_chain_head` is the head of pat's chained energy_observations store (pat ADR-0011 §2) — opaque here; this repo pins only the lowercase-hex discipline.
